plan.disposition: small iterate: external and internal plan/architecture reviews apply at medium and above

findings.finding: No test covers how the client maps countersign_audit_pending, reasonKept/existingReason and loggedAdr.
findings.suggestion: Add fetch-stub tests for these four answers.

findings.finding: ensureRejectAudit reuse ignores supersededAdr; a superseded-rewrite record and a plain reject on one identity can stand in for each other.
findings.suggestion: Document as accepted or match on supersededAdr.

findings.finding: The rowKey comment still says the key includes the array index.
locked also disables Cancel of an open confirmation.

Claim under doubt: the operator approves only what they read: a changed row is marked and locked — A lead replaces a proposal with one under a NEW timestamp in the same position; the refetch mounts a fresh row that is unmarked and clickable, so the changed marker never fires.
findings.suggestion: Mark every row that appears after the first load as new since the window was opened, with the same lock and acknowledgement.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: different from residueKind means the lead really rewrote the proposal — proposalFingerprint hashes the block with only CR removed and the end trimmed: a whitespace-only edit of approved residue reads as different and Reject would record it as rejected.
findings.suggestion: Normalise, or document that a whitespace-only rewrite reads as different.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: any-reason reuse only reuses this webui's own record — A same-OS-user lead can plant a record with any reason; that text is echoed in the notice as if it were the operator's.
findings.suggestion: Label the text as read from the audit file and state the widened pre-emption as accepted.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: a pinned done result of an older version is always shown on its own — settled is keyed by row key only: a second done for another version overwrites the first.
findings.suggestion: Key settled by key and digest.
